events.title: Alex Brightman joins the Cast
events.summary: We're incredibly excited to announce that Alex Brightman, has officially joined the cast of There are No Ghosts at the Grand!Alex plays and sings as the player character, Chris David, a young American man who unexpectedly inherits the Grand and arrives in town with a secret mission of his own. events.title: Officially Selected for the Tribeca Festival 2026
events.summary: No Ghosts At The Grand is in the Official Selection at the Tribeca Festival in New YorkHello everyone! We’re thrilled to in the Official Selection for Tribeca Festival 2026, alongside a brilliant line-up of story-driven games. The Festival was founded by Robert De Niro, Jane Rosenthal, and Craig Hatkoff in 2001. Now celebrating 25 years.
